nisin_a.notes: Includes Nisin Z (P29559, 1-residue swap N27H), Nisin Q (Q939T1), and distant lantibiotics Subtilin and Epidermin.

subtilin.notes: Includes Ericin S homolog and lantibiotics Nisin A and Gallidermin.

epidermin.notes: Includes Gallidermin (P21838, single substitution I6L) and Nisin A.

gallidermin.notes: Includes Epidermin (P08136, single substitution L6I) and Nisin A.

pediocin_pa1.notes: Includes Coagulin (Q47849), Bavaricin A (P80497), Sakacin P (P35618), Leucocin A (P34034), and Enterocin A (P0C988).

sakacin_a.notes: Curvacin A (P36495) differs by only 1 residue (A27E). Pediocin PA-1 and Sakacin P are fellow class IIa members.

sakacin_p.notes: Sakacin 674 is an identical/close variant; Pediocin PA-1 and Leucocin A share the YGNGV box.

leucocin_a.notes: Leucocin B is a close homolog; Pediocin PA-1 and Sakacin P are moderate class IIa relatives.

enterocin_a.notes: Enterocin B/P and Pediocin PA-1 share antilisterial class IIa homology.

curvacin_a.notes: Sakacin A (P26829) is an isogenic/closely related variant differing at residue 27.

carnobacteriocin_b2.notes: Carnobacteriocin BM1 and Pediocin PA-1 share YGNGV motif.

microcin_j25.notes: Enterobacterial lasso peptide homologs sharing macrolactam ring topology.
